author: codex:engineering
context: Continuation of ADR-0030 after scoped PO business decisions and representability correction. Old candidate/runner and evaluation corpus remain frozen.
decision: Preserve a shared exact component inventory; keep audit advisory and human review snapshot-bound. Run only with explicit request authorization and injected generator; debit before each call and forbid replay execution. Real inference requires separately supervised transport and a new approved frozen protocol.

limitations: Synthetic development contract tests do not qualify the model or establish semantic quality.
Boundary invocation budget does not supervise time or hidden transport requests; no real adapter configured.
Human declarations are not authenticated; private artifacts rely on repository filesystem permissions.
No migration of old approvals, reserved outputs, defaults or sprint/story completion.
summary: Provider-independent generation v4, advisory component audit v5, independent human assessment v4 and opt-in injected runner. Exact snapshots, single-use claim, two boundary invocations, first-failure stop and private offline replay.
